text: Stand on this rock, and you're in two countries and two time zones at once.
One step, and your clock jumps an hour.
Half is Sweden, half is Finland.
And the border? It zigzags like it had way too much coffee.
This is market, 350 meters of bare rock.
No trees, no people, just seals.
Sweden loses Finland to the Russian Empire.
fire. The new border? A straight line right through this rock. Then in 1885, Finland builds
a lighthouse on the highest point. All two meters of it. Small problem. That point was
in Sweden. Sweden was not thrilled. The lighthouse? It just liked the view. And there it stood,
in the wrong country for 100 years. And the fix is even weirder. In 1985, instead of
the lighthouse, they move the border. Now the border bends around the tower in a
480 meter S. Finland keeps the lighthouse and Sweden gets the same area back. But
remember Sweden runs one hour behind Finland. So zigzag across that line and
you hop back and forth in time. Sweden's reward? An extra hour of sleep. So next
